run_merge_sharded_dictionaries: run the script to download and merge 200 sharded domain-to-duplicated-texts JSON files from S3
run_filter_duplicate_texts: run the script to filter duplicated texts keeping only entries with counter greater than 2
run_sync_s3_to_local: run the script to sync sharded JSON dictionaries from an S3 bucket to local scratch storage
run_save_merged_dictionary: run the script to save the merged domain-to-duplicated-texts dictionary as a single JSON file
run_remove_end_of_document_tokens: run the script to remove entries containing END_OF_DOCUMENT_TOKEN_TO_BE_REPLACED from the filtered dictionary
